Mixed purées

Chestnut, apple, and chicken

Gesztenyés alma csirkével

6 months+ Sound idea 35 min 4 portions

Serve a smooth spoonful. The chicken is there for iron, and the chestnut must have no pieces.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g cooked peeled chestnuts (plain, no sugar and no salt)
  • 100 g apple (prepared weight, peeled, cored, and cooked)
  • 120 g skinless chicken thigh (raw weight)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Cook the chicken in unsalted water until there is no pink in the middle.
  2. Cook the peeled, cored apple until soft.
  3. Use plain cooked peeled chestnuts, not a sweetened spread.
  4. Blend chicken, apple, and chestnut until completely smooth, with a spoon of cooking water if needed.
  5. Check that no chestnut piece remains.
  6. Do not add salt.

Sound idea

Chestnut must be smooth, because pieces can choke. Fruit alone would miss the iron that the chicken supplies.

Blend cooked chestnut, cooked apple, and fully cooked chicken until smooth. This is a better plate than fruit alone, and no salt is added.
